entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.5.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.5.0** - **USER presets.** A new USER page with 8 slots: tap **SAVE**, then a slot, to keep the sound you have now; tap a slot to bring it back. entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.3.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.3.0** - **AUTO LEVEL** (OUTPUT panel): measures how loud the sound is going in and coming out (over about a second) and evens them up, so a punchier setting isn't just louder. On for a new copy; projects saved before 1.3.0 keep it off so they sound as they did. - **Drum-bus pair presets**: Boom Bap Bus, Lo-Fi Bus, Modern Bus and Glue Bus. They're in PotentialHeat 1.3.0 too, made to work together: put Punch first and Heat after it on your drum bus and pick the same name in each

entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.2.0** - **ROLL**: one tap for a random setting that still sounds good: attack, sustain, speed, focus and mix. **MILD**, **MEDIUM** or **WILD** under it sets how far it goes (MILD adds a little snap, WILD can carve the hits right up). OUTPUT is kept at 0 dB. Keep rolling until you like it, then fine-tune. - The preset keys are a little narrower to make room for it. entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.0.2
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **STOP** or **Overdub** while the MPC was playing could reload the preset and undo your ATTACK / SUSTAIN / MIX tweaks. The MPC's host briefly changes a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was PRESET. That first slot now does nothing; PRESET is a new parameter at the end (same menu, same Q-Link). Saved projects open with their preset and settings as before.

entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.0.1
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.0.1**: bug fix. - **Fixed:** the MPC's **PRESET** menu kept closing (and its list flickered) while PotentialPunch was open. entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.0.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.0.0**, the first release. A transient shaper for your MPC: more or less punch at the start of every hit, and more or less tail after it, with no threshold to set. 12 one-tap presets for drums, breaks and more. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpunch#readme) for everything it does and its limitations. **Download** `PotentialPunch-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below.
